title: Ukrainian Fatty Dumplings
description: Tender, flavorful dumplings filled with a rich, savory mix, served with a side of steamed vegetables.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour and salt. Gradually add water, mixing until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and let rest for 30 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat. Add onion and garlic, sautéing until softened.
Add fatty and ukrainian to the pan, mixing well. Season with salt to taste.
Divide the rested dough into 8 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of the filling mixture in the center of each dough circle. Fold the dough over the filling, pressing edges to seal.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Gently add the dumplings, cooking for 5-7 minutes or until they float to the surface.
Serve the dumplings hot with steamed vegetables.
Optional: serve with a side of sour cream or chopped fresh herbs.
